body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> HANA Electronics(www.hanamp3.com) unveiled its mini karaoke ‘JMC420’ during CES 2008, adopting a new sound source chip developed by the company.

As an mp3 player supporting karaoke function, the JMC420 offers various features of karaoke including background display, echo sound effect as well as lyrics, by adopting the company’s exclusive sound chip. It also plays DVD-level video by delivering 720*480 resolution.
The company’s one-chip solution including CPU and software could be adopted various multimedia devices like cell phone, navigation, set-top box and TV.
